parsed.compliance_time_text: Replace the affected crankshaft at the earliest of: next engine overhaul (per Lycoming Service Instruction 1009AU), next separation of the crankcase, or no later than 12 years from when the crankshaft first entered service or was last overhauled, whichever is later.

effective_date: (a) Effective Date This AD is effective October 24, 2012.
supersedes: This AD supersedes AD 2006-20-09 (71 FR 57407, September 29, 2006).
compliance_time_text: (e) Compliance You are responsible for having the actions required by this AD performed within the compliance times specified unless the actions have already been done.
unsafe_condition_summary: This AD also results from the need to include the IO-390, AEIO-390, and AEIO-580 series engine models having affected crankshafts. We are issuing this AD to prevent failure of the crankshaft, which will result in total engine power loss, in-flight engine failure, and possible loss of the aircraft.
